name: ClownMDEmu [anylinux]
description:
clownmdemu-enhanced is a standalone frontend for clownmdemu, an accurate and modular Sega Mega Drive / Genesis emulator core. It provides a straightforward user interface for playing 16-bit Sega games with high fidelity.

Features:
- Accurate Motorola 68000 and Z80 CPU emulation with cycle-accurate timing
- High-quality Yamaha YM2612 FM synthesis and SN76489 PSG sound reproduction
- Support for Mega Drive / Genesis ROM formats and SRAM battery saves
- Configurable video scaling, scanline filters, and fullscreen display modes
- Gamepad and keyboard configuration with responsive input handling

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
